testId: tests/admin/DashboardPage/DashboardTest.spec.ts > BMP-36 TC5: Invalid credentials do not redirect to the Dashboard

scenario.summary: Storefront sign-in fails with invalid credentials (the project's Admin account with a wrong password, and an unknown username) and the user is not redirected to the BI WORLDWIDE Web Admin Dashboard.
steps: Open the storefront sign-in page (config webstoreURL, /login)
Enter the Admin account's username (config adminUsername, from env ADMIN_USERNAME) with a wrong password made up by the test and sign in
Check that the login error is shown and the Web Admin (/admin) is not opened
Open the sign-in page again, enter an unknown username and password made up by the test and sign in
Check again that the login error is shown and the Web Admin (/admin) is not opened
stateChanges: One failed sign-in attempt on the shared Admin account per run (watch the account lockout threshold); no records created
assertions: Wrong password for the Admin account: the login error is shown; no redirect to the Web Admin Dashboard
Unknown username: the login error is shown; no redirect to the Web Admin Dashboard
Login error text as read from the running app on qa (the story does not fix it)
evidence: Jira BMP-36 negative flow and test case TC5 (work/stories/BMP-36/input/BMP-36-story.md); no FRD

work/stories/BMP-36/analysis.md sections 5 (Q6: both cases, message from the running app) and 6: shared Admin account exception decided by the user 2026-11-26 (the wrong-password case uses it); retarget to the BI WORLDWIDE Web Admin via storefront sign-in decided by the user 2026-11-26
